title: Beyond Benchmark Accuracy: A Diagnostic Test for LLM Chemical Prediction
summary: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. body: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. However, existing evaluation methods typically provide target entity identity information directly, making it difficult to determine whether model predictions arise from transferable structure-property reasoning capabilities or rely on target-related contextual information or memory retrieval. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework to evaluate chemical prediction models when target entity identity information is hidden. In this framework, the target is no longer directly defined by its entity identity, but instead by a known source entity and an explicit structural edit operation. This setting preserves the information required to determine the target while reducing the opportunity for models to access target identity cues. We evaluate this framework across six tasks spanning odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction. The results show that models generally achieve better prediction performance when source and target entity properties are consistent. Providing explicit source entity labels further strengthens this dependence. Moreover, while keeping the target entity, structural change, and ground-truth label unchanged, replacing only the source entity label causes some model predictions to systematically shift toward the substituted source labels. These results indicate that high benchmark accuracy in chemical prediction tasks does not necessarily imply that LLMs possess reliable structure-property reasoning capabilities. Our diagnostic framework provides a controlled evaluation approach for testing whether models can genuinely update predictions according to entity changes. The framework can be extended to other AI for Science tasks, particularly those where targets can be defined through transformations of known entities.
summaryZh: 本文指出当前大模型在化学预测基准上的高准确率可能源于对目标实体身份信息的记忆，而非真正的结构-属性推理能力。为此，作者提出了“身份盲推理诊断框架”，通过隐藏目标实体身份并利用源实体与结构编辑操作进行评估。实验表明，模型预测往往受源实体标签影响，而非基于化学结构推理。该框架为评估AI在科学领域的真实推理能力提供了受控方法，对推动AI for Science的严谨评估具有重要价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 身份盲推理，指在评估中隐藏目标实体身份，以测试模型是否具备真正的结构推理能力。
骨架跳跃，指在分子设计中寻找具有不同核心骨架但功能相似的分子。
逆合成分析，指通过化学反应逆向推导合成目标分子的原料。
结构-属性推理，指基于分子结构预测其物理或化学性质的能力。
诊断框架，用于分析模型在特定任务中表现背后的真实机制。
